questions.stem: Find the derivative of the function f(x) = 4x^3 - 7x^2 + 9x - 2.
questions.explanation: The derivative of a polynomial is found by applying the power rule to each term. The power rule states that if f(x) = x^n, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is forgetting to apply the negative sign when differentiating an even-powered term with an odd exponent (e.g., -7x^2).
